newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-NORDSTROM LOWERED TO BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-NORDSTROM LOWERED TO BUY.

text.p: Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it lowered its rating on retailer Nordstrom Inc to buy from strong buy, citing the stock's 32 percent increase since Dain Bosworth upgraded the stock in May.
--"The stock remains one of the bigger department store opportunities over time and remains recommended for purchase," analyst Dean Ramos said in a research report.

-- Lower service charge income in the third quarter this year and a gain on asset sale last year will have about a $0.05 a share drag on fiscal 1998 third quarter earnings, Ramos wrote, adding that he was lowering the October quarter earnings estimate to $0.45 from $0.47 a share and the full year estimate to $2.40 from $2.45 a share.
-- That compares to $0.42 for the third quarter of fiscal 1997 and $1.84 for full fiscal 1997, Ramos wrote.
-- Nordstrom shares were up /8 at 58 Tuesday.
